description.value: Wakepilot is a premium watersports rental and charter company on Osoyoos Lake — the warmest lake in Canada — with over 20 years of operation and three lakefront locations. They offer Sea-Doo, boat, SUP, kayak, and e-foil rentals alongside wakeboard and surf charters using Supra SA wake boats. Their 2024 Wine Tour by Boat package combines boating with stops at South Okanagan wineries, making it a distinctive activity for touring cyclists who reach the Osoyoos wine country.
